title: ConvolutionFilter SWF flags: CLAMP/PRESERVE_ALPHA bits swapped vs Ruffle (bit0<->bit1)
description: FIXED. writeConvolutionFilter (packages/swf/src/filters.ts) now writes PRESERVE_ALPHA on bit 0 (1<<0) and CLAMP on bit 1 (1<<1), matching the SWF FILTER spec and Ruffle's ConvolutionFilterFlags (verified firsthand against ruffle/swf/src/types/convolution_filter.rs: CLAMP=1<<1, PRESERVE_ALPHA=1<<0). Previously clamp was on bit0 and preserveAlpha on bit1 (swapped), so a published filter clamped/preserved-alpha opposite to the author's setting. Updated convolution-filter.test.ts Test 6 to assert the corrected layout (clamp&0x02, preserveAlpha&0x01) with explanation, and added Test 6b: an encode->Ruffle-decode round-trip over all 4 clamp/preserveAlpha combos. swf suite: 115 files / 1431 tests pass. pnpm --filter './packages/**' build (typecheck) green. No docs bit-layout to update.
